children: The following is a range of analysts' estimates of ethanol production and ethanol inventories for the week ended Sept. 4. Production units are in thousands of barrels per day, while inventories are listed in thousands of barrels. Parentheses indicate a negative number. The report is scheduled to be released at noon ET Thursday by the EIA.
